modelingNotes: Size 6 cover for the upper housing/hood, with side-locking clamps; mechanical accessory only.
The 2011 manufacturer datasheet at the E.B. Horsman mirror corroborates identity and diecast aluminium construction; see research.md, S2, pages 1–2.
No electrical terminals, contact functions or fixed electrical links. Metalwork and the retaining tether do not establish a specified PE/bond connection; assembly bonding is separate.
COVER is an authoring alias for mechanical attachment, not a manufacturer terminal marking.
Current IP65 in plugged condition differs from historical IP66. No environmental or electrical rating is assigned; see research.md.

connectionCoverage.notes: Complete for the exact mechanical cover order: no electrical power, return, PE/bond, shield, signal, communication or optional contact terminals. Associated housings and inserts are separate components.

COVER.description: Mechanical attachment only; no electrical pins.
